WalletDeliveryPayload.description: The wallet-delivery payload: the resolved recipient plus the already-signed credential sent to the LearnCloud POST /credential/send/{profileId} endpoint. synthesis_allowed is false for this phase (no Field Synthesis step provisioned).

recipient_profile_id.description: LearnCard recipient profile id resolved upstream by the Profile Resolver (case-sensitive).

signed_credential.description: The complete signed OBv3 credential from the Issuer Adapter, passed through verbatim as the LearnCloud `credential` body.
